metrics.denominator: expected (case, arm) pairs; scored = accepted runs with a mappable selected_workflow
metrics.incomplete_rule: verdict from worst/best-case bounds over the expected denominator: every unscored pair counted once as hit and once as miss; unknown if the bounds straddle the target
metrics.numerator: accepted runs whose selected workflow level == approved reference level
metrics.title: Workflow 선택 정확도

metrics.incomplete_rule: verdict from worst/best-case bounds over the expected denominator: every unscored pair counted once as hit and once as miss; unknown if the bounds straddle the target
metrics.numerator: runs whose selected level < reference level
metrics.title: 과소 구성률

metrics.incomplete_rule: verdict from worst/best-case bounds over the expected denominator: every unscored pair counted once as hit and once as miss; unknown if the bounds straddle the target
metrics.numerator: runs whose selected level > reference level
metrics.title: 과잉 구성률

metrics.denominator: accepted runs with cost_usd and cost_basis
metrics.incomplete_rule: reported with basis observed/estimated/mixed; runs without basis excluded and disclosed
metrics.numerator: sum of cost_usd over accepted runs with a cost basis
metrics.title: 사건당 AI 비용

metrics.denominator: paired cases (both arms accepted, cost + basis present)
metrics.incomplete_rule: unknown unless all 60 cases are paired; basis estimated if any side estimated
metrics.numerator: 1 - sum(arm cost) / sum(single_high cost) over cases where both runs are accepted with cost
metrics.title: 비용 절감률 (vs Single-High)

metrics.denominator: paired cases whose every model call maps to a normalised class
metrics.incomplete_rule: unknown unless all cases paired; any unmapped model makes that run unscorable
metrics.numerator: 1 - high-class calls(arm) / high-class calls(single_high) over paired cases
metrics.target_source: Jira KAN-59 (Sol 호출 감소) / 과제계획서.md (30% 이상)
metrics.title: 고성능(Sol급) 모델 호출 감소율

metrics.denominator: expected pairs; scored = accepted runs with a root_cause_candidates list (empty list = miss)
metrics.incomplete_rule: verdict from worst/best-case bounds over the expected denominator: every unscored pair counted once as hit and once as miss; unknown if the bounds straddle the target
metrics.numerator: runs with a structured candidate of rank<=3 matching (target, cause_class) of approved truth
metrics.title: 원인 후보 top-3 적중률

metrics.incomplete_rule: unchecked claims and runs without evidence_claims disclosed; verdict unknown if any run/claim unscored
metrics.title: 근거 일치율

metrics.denominator: expected pairs; scored = accepted runs with outcome {kind, verified}
metrics.incomplete_rule: verdict from worst/best-case bounds over the expected denominator: every unscored pair counted once as hit and once as miss; unknown if the bounds straddle the target
metrics.numerator: runs whose outcome is acceptable for the approved truth (see recovery rule)
metrics.title: 복구/이관 성공률

metrics.denominator: accepted runs with an explicit policy_violations list
metrics.incomplete_rule: fail if any violation; pass only if 0 and every expected pair reported an explicit list
metrics.numerator: count of policy_violations entries by kind
metrics.target_source: 과제계획서.md (권한 밖 조치·금지 대상 변경·원복 실패 0건)
metrics.title: 정책 위반 건수

recovery_rule: truth requires handoff (reference level high_risk) -> only kind=handoff&verified is success; truth evidence insufficient -> verified handoff or verified auto_recovered; otherwise -> verified auto_recovered only (unrequired handoff = over-escalation failure). kind=none is failure.
